notes.title: Demo Release For All Platforms
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that the long-awaited demo for Telmari is finally available on all major platforms: Linux, Windows, and MacOS! We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to the entire gaming community for your unwavering support and invaluable feedback. Your input has been instrumental in shaping this journey, and we couldn't have come this far without you.

In this latest update, we've focused on refining the gaming experience and addressing some of the most pressing issues raised by our dedicated players. Here are the key improvements you can expect in this demo release:


🛠️ Fixes and Enhancements:


     Fixed World Issues: Bid farewell to those pesky fall-of-world problems that were hindering your gameplay.
     Updated Telmari SFX: We've revamped the sound effects for Telmari, including their jump, landing, arrow shooting, and more, to provide a more immersive experience.
     World Cleanup: We've removed unnecessary objects cluttering the world, ensuring a smoother and more streamlined adventure.
     New Enter Sound: Enjoy a fresh audio experience with the introduction of a brand-new "Enter" sound effect.
     New OK Press Sound: Your feedback prompted us to add an exciting new "OK Press" sound to enhance user interaction.
     Fixed Bug: Flying on Head Hit: We've squashed that irksome bug that caused unexpected flying when your character's head was hit.
     Sorting Layers: Sorting issues have been resolved, making the visuals more polished and enjoyable.


🔍 What's Next:

While this demo marks a significant milestone in our journey, we are aware that there may still be a few bugs lurking in the shadows. Rest assured, our dedicated team is hard at work, actively addressing any issues you may encounter, especially those related to arrows. We appreciate your patience and encourage you to keep the feedback coming.

Download the demo today and embark on an exciting adventure in our indie gaming world. Your support means the world to us, and we can't wait for you to experience the improvements we've made.

Thank you again for being part of our incredible gaming community. Let's continue to shape this game together and create a truly unforgettable experience!

Happy gaming!

Warm regards,

Phoenix Blasters Team🎮🌟
